0.0: This note has been cast with a very sophisticated set of alchemy. Whoever wrote this note must be a highly-trained alchemist. This is not going to be an easy task. It will take a bit of time to extract the hidden text.
0.1: But...if you are a strong, powerful individual, then there's a much, much easier way to extract the hidden text. Are you interested in taking that route instead?

yes.0: I want you to bring some Homunscullo's Blood for me. It contains a mysterious power that reveals the truth from anything, but it's very difficult to extract.   Blood from that angry, formidable monster is rather hard to come by, you know.

no.0: If you can't do that, then I'll have to break the spell with alchemy, but... the items required for this are just as hard to obtain. Not only that, it'll take me about...197 years, 6 weeks, 2 days, 4 hours and 16 minutes to create a potion that'll allow us to read the hidden message. Are you okay with that?  Or, should I say, will your children be ok with that?
